routes.name: Waiting for Donkey Kong
routes.desc: Old rusty bolts. Do not climb!

routes.name: Don't Worry, Be Happy
routes.desc: Starts with 'King Fisher', but goes straight up the shorter anchor. Not rebolted with titanium. 6 old slings, 1 stainless steel glue-in bolt. Replace slings if you want to climb this.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Not rebolted with titanium. 6 old slings, 1 stainless steel glue-in bolt.

routes.name: King Fisher
routes.desc: Climbs 'Don't Worry, Be Happy', but veers right before the last clip. Maybe the classic on the crag, but needs rebolting. Last rebolting 2008, but only stainless steel glue-ins, which cannot be trusted anymore. 8 bolts, 5 slings.

routes.name: Land of Smiles
routes.desc: Only first pitch rebolted with titanium. 1. 5 titanium bolts, 3 slings. 2. Old rusty bolts. Do not climb!

routes.name: Coral Soul
routes.desc: Alternative second pitch of 'Land of Smiles', but also not rebolted. Old rusty bolts. Do not climb!
warnings: Fixed Gear: Alternative second pitch of 'Land of Smiles', but also not rebolted. Old rusty bolts.

routes.name: Gecko Blaster / Happy Project
routes.desc: Old stainless steel glue-ins. Needs rebolting.

routes.name: Violent Brain Fever

routes.name: Happy Thailand

routes.name: Razorback
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'TV Route' and anchors with 'Happy Thailand'. First pitch rebolted in 2000, but only with stainless steel glue-ins. Second pitch expansion bolts. Do not climb until rebolted!
warnings: Fixed Gear: Second pitch expansion bolts.
Climbing: Do not climb until rebolted!
